mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pd.id AS skuId, pd.images_url, pd.sku_no, pc.country, pc.country_name as countryName, pc.to_declare_price as toDeclarePrice, pc.to_currency as toCurrency, pc.to_currency_symbol as toCurrencySymbol, pc.customs_code, pc.tax_rate, pc.type FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_customs pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.id = #{skuId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pd.id desc
